user.title: Hue Remote Scenes
user.description: Adds a Hue remote scenes panel to the sidebar, and a scene entity for each scene you save. Your ZHA groups are used as they are.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Hue Remote Scenes is already set up.
abort.no_zha: ZHA isn't set up in Home Assistant. Set it up first.

store_scene.name: Store scene
store_scene.description: Save the group's lights as they are now into a Zigbee scene on each light. Give a name for a new scene, or a scene ID to overwrite one.

group_id.name: Group ID
group_id.description: The ZHA group's ID (shown in the Hue remote scenes panel).

scene_id.name: Scene ID
scene_id.description: An existing scene to overwrite with the current state.

import_scenes.name: Import scenes
import_scenes.description: Ask the group's lights which scenes they already have (for example, ones made in Zigbee2MQTT) and add any that are missing.
